fields.System.Title: Add NHS number validation to patient intake form
fields.System.Description:
The intake form accepts any 10 digits as an NHS number. Clinicians have entered numbers that fail the Modulus 11 check, which then bounce when we sync to the Spine.

Validate the number as the receptionist types it and block submission if it is invalid. Formatting with spaces (943 476 5919) must still be accepted.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
• Numbers failing the Modulus 11 check show an inline error on blur.
  • Spaces and hyphens are stripped before validation.
  • The Save button is disabled while the number is invalid.
  • Unit tests cover the published NHS test numbers.

fields.System.Title: Appointment reminders send twice when clocks change
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.TCM.ReproSteps:
1. Create an appointment for 02:30 on the last Sunday of October.
  2. Wait for the reminder job to run across the clock change.
  3. Two reminder texts are sent.
Expected: one reminder.
